# rvis

**Interactive charts with one calling convention, and shiny dashboards
from a configuration file.**

- **Charts**:
  [`rvisPlot()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisPlot.md)
  draws interactive charts with about 30 plotting packages (echarts4r,
  highcharter, plotly, apexcharter, amCharts, billboarder, c3, dygraphs,
  visNetwork, networkD3, DT, …) using the same arguments: the data, the
  columns to show and a list of settings. Changing the package that
  draws a chart is changing one word.
- **Dashboards**:
  [`rvisDashboard()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisDashboard.md)
  builds a complete shiny app from a YAML or JSON file (or an R list)
  naming its inputs, outputs, containers and layout, with the R code of
  its outputs. Any function of any package can be a dashboard item.
- **Interactive charts**: clicks on nodes, links, bars, points, table
  cells or map markers become shiny inputs: directly for 13 plotting
  packages, and for any other htmlwidget with a CSS selector, without
  changing the javascript of the packages.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("genpack/rvis")
```

The plotting packages are optional: install those whose charts you use,
for example `install.packages(c("echarts4r", "highcharter", "plotly"))`.
See [Get
started](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/articles/rvis.html#installation)
for the full list.

## A chart

``` r

library(rvis)
deaths <- data.frame(age = rownames(VADeaths), VADeaths, check.names = FALSE)

rvisPlot(type = "bar", plotter = "echarts", obj = deaths,
         x = "age", y = list("Rural Male", "Urban Male"),
         config = list(title = "Death rates in Virginia", yAxis.label = "per 1000"))

# the same chart drawn by another package:
rvisPlot(type = "bar", plotter = "highcharter", obj = deaths,
         x = "age", y = list("Rural Male", "Urban Male"))
```

## A dashboard

``` yaml
name: Hello rvis
layout: page
items:
  page: {type: sidebarLayout, title: Hello rvis!, layout.side: [bins], layout.main: [hist]}
  bins: {type: sliderInput, title: "Number of bins:", min: 1, max: 50, value: 30}
  hist:
    type: plotOutput
    service: hist(faithful$waiting, breaks = input$bins)
```

``` r

runDashboard("hello.yml")
rvisDashboardExample()      # 40 example dashboards, including the apps of the Shiny gallery
```

# Package index

## Charts

Draw a chart with any plotter, and send clicks on its items to shiny.

- [`rvisPlot()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisPlot.md) :
  Plot with an rvis wrapper
- [`rvisClickEvents()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisClickEvents.md)
  : Send clicks on a chart to shiny
- [`df2Network()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/df2Network.md)
  : Build a network from the levels of a table
- [`plotHtml()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/plotHtml.md) :
  Show a chart in the web browser

## Dashboards

Build and run shiny dashboards from YAML, JSON or R list configurations.

- [`rvisDashboard()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisDashboard.md)
  : Build a dashboard from a configuration
- [`runDashboard()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/runDashboard.md)
  : Run a dashboard
- [`rvisDashboardExample()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvisDashboardExample.md)
  : Example dashboards
- [`DASHBOARD-class`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/DASHBOARD-class.md)
  [`DASHBOARD`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/DASHBOARD-class.md)
  : Dashboard objects
- [`build.container.get.table()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/build.container.get.table.md)
  : Dashboard items of a dialog reading a CSV table
- [`style.css()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/style.css.md)
  : Inline CSS style

## Settings and data

Settings of the plotters, chart types and shared defaults.

- [`properties`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/properties.md)
  : Configuration settings of the plotters
- [`plotters`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/plotters.md) :
  Chart types of the plotters
- [`rvis-constants`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis-constants.md)
  [`valid.dim.names`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis-constants.md)
  [`valid.plot.types`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis-constants.md)
  [`valid.plotters`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis-constants.md)
  [`defset`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis-constants.md)
  : Names, chart types and settings shared by the plotters

## Package

- [`rvis-package`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis.md)
  [`rvis`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/rvis.md) : rvis:
  interactive charts and shiny dashboards

## Legacy functions

Older functions kept for existing code.

- [`DT.Table()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/DT.Table.md)
  [`DT.Table.Classify.bold()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/DT.Table.md)
  : Legacy DT table functions
- [`leaflet.map.plot()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/leaflet.map.plot.md)
  [`leaflet.map.Zoom()`](https://genpack.github.io/rvis/reference/leaflet.map.plot.md)
  : Legacy leaflet map functions
